name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak reached 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths by 10 Nov, ECDC says
state: ECDC's 12 Nov update reports 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths in DR Congo, with data to 10 Nov; Kenya has nine cases and two deaths (ECDC). WHO's 6 Nov outbreak report counted 10,668 cases and 5,198 deaths to 3 Nov across 67 health zones in eight provinces, with Nigeria reporting one imported case on 20 Oct (WHO). Cases far exceed the 1,000 Alert line.
for_you: Follow UKHSA and NaTHNaC advice if travelling to DR Congo or neighbouring countries; ECDC rates the risk to the general European population as very low.
basis_detail: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts
basis_by: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts

sources.title: ECDC — Ebola disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, update 12 Nov

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
